₹500 SIP se crorepati? 🤔

Haan, par slow:
10 saal → ~₹1.16L
30 saal → ~₹17.6L
₹1 crore → ~45 saal

Trick: har saal SIP +10% → ₹1 crore ~36 saal mein 🚀

₹500 se shuru karo. Bas ₹500 pe ruko mat.

12% per year maan kar, sirf example. Koi guarantee nahi.
📌 Sirf educational content. SEBI-registered nahi. Investment advice nahi.
